title: Dordiai cancellation recovery fixture uses the current authority operation
reason: The existing two recovery cases directly called the private _start_worker after the current authority had begun requiring an active same-thread operation. Actual cancellation/drop and first-worker disposal passed, then prewarming failed at runtime_configuration's current operation guard.
change: Enclose only the existing private recovery prewarm, launch-bound readiness and nested public recovery stream/assertions in the actual adapter._authority_scope(). The fixture uses the unmanaged no-package namespace; the same-thread nested stream retains the existing authority.
limitation: Not executed. The actual two previously failing recovery cases must rerun; transport fixtures do not qualify models, acoustic quality, physical output or NVDA.

inverse_operations.old:
recovered_worker = adapter._start_worker()
    assert recovered_worker.process.pid != cancelled_worker.process.pid
    wait_for(lambda: ready_worker_pid(runtime, recovery_nonce) is not None, timeout=5.0)
    actor_pid = ready_worker_pid(runtime, recovery_nonce)
    assert actor_pid is not None
    assert recovered_worker.process.poll() is None and adapter.request_timeout == 1.0
    assert len(list(adapter.stream_pcm("After cancellation.", "speaker_a", "uk"))) == 2
    assert adapter._worker is recovered_worker
    recovery_requests = [r for r in records(runtime) if r["launch_nonce"] == recovery_nonce]
    assert {r["pid"] for r in recovery_requests} == {actor_pid}
    assert [r["mode"] for r in recovery_requests] == [
        "reference", "next", "next"]
inverse_operations.new:
# Prewarming is part of the same real authority operation as recovery.
    with adapter._authority_scope():
        recovered_worker = adapter._start_worker()
        assert recovered_worker.process.pid != cancelled_worker.process.pid
        wait_for(lambda: ready_worker_pid(runtime, recovery_nonce) is not None, timeout=5.0)
        actor_pid = ready_worker_pid(runtime, recovery_nonce)
        assert actor_pid is not None
        assert recovered_worker.process.poll() is None and adapter.request_timeout == 1.0
        assert len(list(adapter.stream_pcm("After cancellation.", "speaker_a", "uk"))) == 2
        assert adapter._worker is recovered_worker
        recovery_requests = [r for r in records(runtime) if r["launch_nonce"] == recovery_nonce]
        assert {r["pid"] for r in recovery_requests} == {actor_pid}
        assert [r["mode"] for r in recovery_requests] == [
            "reference", "next", "next"]
